column1: # comment: Canonical GMEOW property alignments. equivalentProperty for same-typed synonyms; skos:closeMatch for cross-type/fuzzy links.

column7: DPV Generalisation (reduce granularity/precision by grouping or rounding) — the privacy-technique counterpart of the gmeow:coarsenTo projection-time directive; the seam to PRIV-GEN (#73)
SKOS broader — the generic hierarchical-order counterpart of the granularity-level ordering gmeow:coarserThan
foaf:mbox is an IRI; close not equivalent
BFO has-part is the OBO hub; GMEOW hasPart is broader and keeps specialized subproperties for precise semantics
CIDOC CRM P46 is composed of — narrower than GMEOW universal hasPart
BFO continuant/occurrent parthood is the OBO hub; GMEOW partOf is a broader universal spine across modules
CIDOC CRM P46 inverse forms part of — physical/conceptual object parthood; narrower than GMEOW universal partOf

Intentional cross-category closeMatch: gUFO's TemporaryParthoodSituation class is the reified reference pattern for mutable endurant parthood; GMEOW partOf remains the flat property shortcut, not an OWL property equivalence
gUFO collection membership is intransitive member-to-collection parthood; a narrower case of the GMEOW universal spine
gUFO component parthood is endurant/component-specific and not generally transitive; GMEOW partOf is broader
gUFO subcollection parthood is collection-specific; GMEOW partOf is the broader cross-module spine
